responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines the eBPF target’s RTL patterns for atomic memory operations beyond the generic instruction set file, specifically fetch-and-modify atomics, atomic exchange, and compare-and-swap for SI and DI modes. It maps GCC atomic expanders onto BPF v3 atomic instructions such as afadd/afand/afor/afxor, axchg, and acmp, encodes the R0-based compare-exchange calling convention and success-result expansion, and preserves the target’s memory-model-sensitive distinction between fetching and non-fetching atomic forms during instruction selection.
